description:
## Problem

SOGRAND soft-output is insufficient for dRM(32,21) in the product code turbo decoder.

## Solution

Implemented a trellis-based Forward-Backward (BCJR) SISO decoder for dRM(32,21). BCJR computes exact APP LLRs without noise pattern enumeration.

## Results

With the corrected dRM(32,21) code (d_min=6, issue 8b1609a8):
- BCJR turbo at 1.0 dB: BLER=0.207 (2.9x of paper's 0.072)
- BCJR turbo at 1.5 dB: BLER=0.0045 (2.6x of paper's 0.00174)
- Product code outperforms LDPC BP at 1.75+ dB

The original 6.5x gap was caused by the wrong code construction (d_min=4 vs d_min=6), not the BCJR decoder. Single-component BCJR was always near-perfect (1.07x at 0.5 dB).

Also fixed: BCJR/list-BLER-threshold integration bug (premature early termination when threshold is set in BCJR mode).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. ✅ BCJR decoder produces per-bit APP LLRs for dRM(32,21) component code.
2. ✅ Extrinsic LLRs (APP - input) are correctly computed for turbo decoder integration.
3. ✅ Product code turbo decoder can use BCJR as alternative to SOGRAND for component decoding.
4. ✅ With corrected dRM(32,21) code (8b1609a8), BCJR turbo achieves BLER=0.207 at 1.0 dB — within 2.9x of paper. Original gap was code construction, not BCJR quality.
5. ✅ eBCH component codes also supported via BCJR.
title: Implement trellis-based SISO decoder for dRM(32,21) component code
